Also there is "集资诈骗" which is for fraudulent fundraising with deception. The facts mention "变相吸收公众存款" and "严重扰乱金融秩序". The typical charge for such is illegal public deposit collection. In examples, similar facts (e.g., first example) used "非法吸收公众存款". So answer: [罪名]非法吸收公众存款<eoa>
